description: Find Solana token pairs matching a ticker or name and return candidates ranked by reported liquidity. Use the mint address from a result to disambiguate duplicate tickers. Results come from DexScreener and can be incomplete. Example: {"query":"BONK"} Cost: 3 free calls, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402. Calls that return an error are not charged.

query.description: Token ticker, project name, or mint text to search for (for example, BONK).

name: resolve_token_symbol
